EDMP.description: Change Element Dependent Material Property (EDMP). Assigns an element-dependent material property (Notional Size h, or Volume/Surface ratio) to the selected frame elements; the H value is either supplied directly (AUTO=false) or auto-calculated from a design code and parameter (AUTO=true, NSM type only).

Argument.description: Request body for the Change Element Dependent Material Property operation.

NODE_ELEMS.description: Selection of the elements to receive the property. Only frame-type elements among the selection are processed; an empty result raises an error.

KEYS.description: Explicit list of node/element IDs to select.

TYPE.description: Property type. NSM = Notional Size Method (constraint h > 0); VSR = Volume-Surface Ratio (constraint v/s > 0). Case-insensitive.

AUTO.description: Auto Calculate. When true, H is auto-calculated from CODE and PARAMETER (only valid for TYPE=NSM; TYPE=VSR raises an error). When false, H_VS must be supplied.

H_VS.description: [AUTO=false] H value (Notional Size) or Volume/Surface ratio to assign directly. Required when AUTO is false; must be > 0.

CODE.description: [AUTO=true] Design code used for auto calculation of the notional size. Matched against "CEB-FIP(1990)", "Korean Standard", "Chinese Standard", "Japanese Standard"; unmatched values fall back to Korean Standard.

PARAMETER.description: [AUTO=true] Parameter passed to the notional size auto-calculation routine.
